posts.title: Update 4
posts.description: For anyone who is checking in from Quora yes, I’ve been edit-blocked from Quora again until mid November, either for using the word “rape” in an answer to a question about rape case, for using the words “sexual harassment” in answer to a question about sexual harassment, or for calling out an anti-Semitic conspiracy theorist. posts.title: An open letter to J.K. Rowling
posts.description: An open letter to JK Rowling from a friend of her late science teacher (i.e. me) explaining the complications of sexual development in the mammalian embryo and the various exciting ways it can go wrong, plus comments on the social effects of the Harry Potter books. Filed under both fiction and biology. The post An open letter to J.K. Rowling appeared first on Old Tails for New Primates .

posts.title: Fear and Loathing in Little Whinging
posts.description: A meditation on the links between story-telling, fanfiction, fanon and propaganda, with particular reference to the phenomenon of "Snape haters" in the Harry Potter fandom. The post Fear and Loathing in Little Whinging appeared first on Old Tails for New Primates .
